documents.name: Acadia National Park
documents.summary: A rare U.S. national park where rugged Atlantic coast, granite mountains, ponds and carriage roads create exceptional multi-day variety in a compact area.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The park is strong enough to anchor a Maine itinerary and remains rewarding across multiple effort levels rather than requiring one technical route.

booking.note: General park entry and specific Cadillac vehicle reservation rules are separate; recheck current NPS requirements.

coreExperience.note: English is the operating language.

nonresident-entry-fee.label: Extra 2026 nonresident entrance fee
nonresident-entry-fee.note: Non-U.S. residents aged 16 and older must pay an additional US$100 per person at Acadia unless admitted with a qualifying Annual or America the Beautiful pass. Check the current NPS fees page before travel.

route-specific-safety.label: Check exact trail conditions and exposure
route-specific-safety.note: Acadia includes optional exposed/ladder routes; this parent entity does not imply those routes are suitable for every visitor.

documents.name: Disneyland Park
documents.summary: Extraordinary attraction density combines classic Disney originals, strong modern headliners and a compact, highly legible park.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Independent visitors and specialist readers repeatedly treat Disneyland itself—not merely the resort brand—as a trip-defining park and credible best-in-class benchmark.

booking.note: Check current tickets, calendar and attraction availability before travel.

coreExperience.note: English is primary; much ride enjoyment is visual.

safety.note: Ride safety instructions are primarily English.

mobility.note: Ride-specific access and transfer rules vary.

documents.name: New Orleans
documents.summary: A singular US city where live music, Creole and Cajun foodways, historic architecture and street culture reinforce each other at destination scale.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Few US destinations offer such a concentrated, internally coherent cultural experience; New Orleans can legitimately justify changing an itinerary around the city itself.

coreExperience.note: English is sufficient for the core experience.

legacy-effort-required.label: Effort required
legacy-effort-required.note: Moderate urban walking; car usually unnecessary in the core.

documents.name: Universal Islands of Adventure
documents.summary: VelociCoaster, Hagrid's Motorbike Adventure, Spider-Man and Hogsmeade combine elite rides with unusually strong themed environments across multiple audience groups.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Current visitor reports and specialist reader surveys repeatedly support best-in-class ride quality and whole-park destination worthiness strong enough to change an Orlando itinerary.

booking.note: Check the current official calendar and ticket rules; special events and premium queue products may use separate requirements.

documents.name: Biltmore Estate
documents.summary: A vast Gilded Age estate anchored by America's largest private home, with Olmsted-designed gardens and enough house, landscape and estate programming to justify a dedicated half- or full-day detour.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The scale, preservation and architectural/landscape pairing are exceptional in the U.S.; independent specialist coverage and current visitor evidence repeatedly treat it as an Asheville trip anchor despite unusually high admission prices.

booking.note: Biltmore House reservations are required every day; advance online purchase protects preferred dates/times.

duration.note: The house, gardens and estate justify at least half a day; a full day better matches the ticket cost and scale.

coreExperience.note: House audio interpretation and most visitor information are English-first.
Architecture/gardens remain legible, but historical interpretation is English-heavy.

mobility.note: Large grounds and stairs create real physical demand; elevators/support exist but do not make every area equally accessible.

walking.label: Plan for substantial walking and stairs

documents.name: Breaks Interstate Park
documents.summary: A remote Virginia–Kentucky gorge park whose strongest visit links sandstone cliffs, rock shelters and Russell Fork rim views on short but rugged trails.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The combination of a deep Appalachian gorge, dense rock formations and genuinely adventurous short hiking is strong enough to justify a rural detour.

coreExperience.note: English is sufficient for the core experience.

documents.name: Brooklyn Botanic Garden
documents.summary: A concentrated 52-acre botanical garden whose Japanese, native and seasonal landscapes remain worthwhile beyond its famous cherry-blossom window.

coreExperience.note: English is the operating language; no material language barrier was identified for an English-speaking visitor.

documents.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park
documents.summary: An 85-acre Brooklyn waterfront park that turns iconic Manhattan-and-bridge views into a varied, walkable public-space experience.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Few free New York experiences combine this level of landmark scenery with enough landscape and activity to support an unhurried multi-hour visit.

coreExperience.note: English is the operating language; no material language barrier was identified for an English-speaking visitor.

documents.name: Busch Gardens Williamsburg
documents.summary: A strong coaster roster sits inside unusually attractive European-village landscaping, with train, skyride, shows and food adding real non-coaster depth.

documents.name: Dollywood

documents.summary: A deep immigration-history museum inside the restored Ellis Island processing complex, best treated as a substantial visit rather than a Statue add-on.

documents.name: EPCOT

documents.whyWorthwhile: Independent evidence supports a meaningful Orlando detour for the park's combination of rides, food, architecture and evening atmosphere.

documents.name: Everglades National Park
documents.summary: A globally distinctive subtropical-wetland national park where wildlife-rich sloughs, mangroves, paddling and the long road to Florida Bay create an ecosystem-scale destination unlike conventional scenic parks.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The 'river of grass' and mangrove-to-Florida-Bay ecosystem are category-level singular in the U.S.; with patient wildlife viewing and the right season, the park justifies a dedicated day or longer rather than a quick roadside stop.

booking.note: Park entry generally needs no timed reservation; tours, tram, camping/backcountry permits and rentals can require separate booking.

coreExperience.note: Wildlife/nature is largely nonverbal, while ranger programs and interpretation are English-first.

booking.note: Book lodging, tours and selected tasting rooms in peak periods; the region itself has no single admission.

duration.note: Three to seven days supports a focused cluster; trying to cover the whole region quickly creates excessive driving.
